indicator.name: Own-source revenue target attainment
indicator.description: County own-source revenue collected as a percentage of the published FY2024/25 target.
indicator.expected_source: National Treasury 2025 BROP using Controller of Budget data
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published for all 47 counties for FY2024/25. Values retain the source table’s whole-percentage precision.

observations.notes: Published full-year own-source revenue target attainment, including FIF/AiA, retained at the whole-percentage precision in the 2025 BROP. The source document identifies Controller of Budget data; no interpolation or county substitution is used.
